title: InstrumentContract
description: Registration of an instrument before it may produce receipts (docs/design/m0/06 "Instrument contracts"). Cross-field rules (no predicate both required and optional, artifact names used by receipts) belong to internal/receipt.

digest.description: Hash of the code and configuration that produce receipts.

required_predicates.description: The coverage a complete receipt must have.

preconditions.description: Environment checks before each run (12); a failure is a precondition_failed hold, not a spent attempt.

payload_schema.description: Blob digest of the JSON Schema for typed predicate fields (rule 7); null means the instrument's predicates carry no payload.
